PrivateType is a private, local push-to-talk dictation app for Windows. Hold a shortcut, speak, and release it to insert text into the field where dictation began, without cloud recognition. Nothing you say is written to disk.

## New in this release

### Signed by its maker

- **`PrivateType.exe` is now signed** by **Open Source Developer Krzysztof Kołodziejczak** (Certum code-signing certificate). Right-click the file, open **Properties → Digital Signatures** to check it.

### Switching versions in one step

- **Starting a new version while the old one runs no longer fails.** PrivateType asks which version to use; **Use** closes the old one, and the new one starts with your shared settings. Only one copy runs at a time.
- **PrivateType asks before another version takes over Windows startup,** whether it is older or newer. It used to switch a newer version silently.
- Versions up to 1.6.0 can't be asked to quit, so the old copy is closed at once; a dictation in progress there is lost. Later versions close cleanly.

### Setup asks how your words should appear

- **Setup starts with the choice that matters:** see your words while you still hold the shortcut, or get them after you let go. Each card shows what that looks like and which languages it covers.
- **You see what will be downloaded before it starts:** the size, where it comes from, where it's kept and its license. Then setup checks the download and tells you when it's ready.
- A full disk or a failed check is named as such. If the speech engine can't start, setup links to the Visual C++ Redistributable.

### The bubble shows what happened

- **While you dictate, the bubble is a caption card** that says what PrivateType is doing.
- **Text that couldn't be inserted isn't lost:** the card shows it with **Copy**, then **Ctrl+V** pastes it. It also says whether the dictation is in **Recent dictations**.
- Each failure offers one next step, such as **Microphone settings** or **Open diagnostics**, and stays long enough to read.
- While the model loads, the bubble says so, and listening starts as soon as it's ready.
- Screen readers now hear the bubble's state and messages.

### Diagnostics and Licenses

- **Diagnostics leads with the latest problem as a plain sentence.** Other events are listed by title; select one to see its raw line. **Copy** and **Save** say what they did.
- **Licenses is now a credits page:** what PrivateType is built with, what each part does, and its license, with buttons for the full notices and the license folder.

### A cleaner look

- Shortcuts are drawn as keycaps throughout Settings, setup, Recent dictations and the bubble.
- Text uses Segoe UI Variable; keys, file names and versions stay in a fixed-width face.
- Settings is wider, so every language name fits its picker.
- Every waiting, empty or stopped window says what is happening and what to do next.
- Windows sit on whole pixels, so text, switches, checkboxes and icons are sharp.

## Download and start

1. Download `PrivateType-1.6.1-win-x64.zip` and `PrivateType-1.6.1-win-x64.zip.sha256` below.
2. Verify the SHA-256 checksum.
3. Extract the complete ZIP into a writable folder.
4. Open `PrivateType 1.6.1` and double-click `PrivateType.exe`.
5. If an earlier version is still running, choose **Use 1.6.1** to switch. If you used a version before 1.4, accept the offer to import its settings. Otherwise, choose a speech model and approve its separate download if it is not already in the shared cache.

The certificate is new, so Windows SmartScreen may still show "Windows protected your PC" until it builds reputation. **More info** shows the publisher, Open Source Developer Krzysztof Kołodziejczak; **Run anyway** starts PrivateType.

Speech models are not bundled in the ZIP. PrivateType downloads the one you choose directly from NVIDIA on Hugging Face and verifies its pinned size and SHA-256 hash before use. Models already downloaded by versions 1.2.0 and later are reused.

## Requirements

- 64-bit Windows 10 or Windows 11 with an x86-64 CPU. No graphics card is needed, but one makes transcription several times faster.
- 8 GB RAM recommended. The loaded model uses about 0.8–1.4 GiB of memory, or graphics memory instead when it runs on a graphics card.
- About 1.2 GB free disk space for the app, one model, and working room
- [Microsoft Visual C++ x64 Redistributable](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/latest-supported-vc-redist), if it isn't already installed

## Privacy

Speech recognition runs locally. PrivateType has no account, cloud-recognition fallback, telemetry, or retained audio. Recent dictations stay in memory only and can be turned off in Settings. The shared settings file stores preferences and vocabulary, never audio or dictated text. Review diagnostic reports before sharing them because application diagnostics can still contain information about your computer environment.
